newsitem.title: USA: National City to increase number of shares.
newsitem.headline: National City to increase number of shares.

text.p: National City Corp on Monday said it would increase the number of shares of its capital stock to 705 million from 355 million.

The National City board wants the extra shares available for use in connection with possible acquisitions, equity financing arrangements, stock dividends or other distributions, employee stock incentive programs, dividend reinvestment programs, or other general corporate purposes, it said.

Speaking at the company's annual meeting in Cleveland, National City Chairman and Chief Executive David Daberko did not address specific plans for the potential new stock, but he discussed corporate initiatives aimed at further improving the company's performance, the company said in a statement.
Among the initiatives, Daberko said the company planned to consolidate its five Ohio banks under a single charter. The consolidation was expected to be completed by early 1998.
